author: ETA PRIME
description: Is lying flat the secret to unlocking max performance? 🤯 Checking out the ROG NUC 16 Edition 20—ASUS’s 20th Anniversary 3-liter mini PC powerhouse packed with an Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX CPU and RTX 5090 GPU. Thanks to a built-in G-sensor, this mini beast automatically detects its orientation and adjusts TDP. Laying it flat horizontally allows the dual vapor chamber cooling to work with gravity rather than against it
title: Don’t Stand This PC Up!! #minipc #rog #gaming
